Message:
md: Make calc_dev_sboffset() return a sector count.

As BLOCK_SIZE_BITS is 10 and

	MD_NEW_SIZE_SECTORS(2 * x) = 2 * NEW_SIZE_BLOCKS(x),

the return value of calc_dev_sboffset() doubles. Fix up all three
callers accordingly.
